title_sq: Tek Ish Ekspozita, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Organizim Perfekt!!!
description_sq: Apartamenti Ndodhet ne Zonen me te mire te Tiranes,vetem 5 minuta larg nga Qendra. I ndodhur ne katin e 9-te te nje pallati te ri te pajisur me ashensor, me termoizolim dhe punime shume cilesore ne hapesirat e perbashketa. Apartamenti ka nje planimetri perfekte me siperfaqe 92 m2 neto ne certifikat. Organizimi i tij eshte si me poshte: nje korridor i cili te lidh me sallonin e ndenjes dhe kendin e gatimit te vecuar, si dhe me dalje ne ballkon. Vecoria e ketij apartamenti ne hapesirat e dites eshte vetrata e xhamit, e cilat i mundeson apartamentit nje ndricim natyral ne pjesen me te madhe te dites. Ne hapesirat e nates apartamenti disponon dy dhoma gjumi matrimoniale, me nje hapesire shume te bollshme dhe me nje investim cilesor. Ne apartament jane dy tualete te cilat jane te aksesueshme lehtesisht nga te gjitha ambientet. Momentalisht njeri prej tualeteve eshte pershtatur ne depo per nevojat e familjareve. Por mund te kthehet lehtësisht në gjëndjen e tij të mëparshme. Apartamenti është rikonstruktuar dhe dallohet lehtësisht per instalimet elektrike dhe hidraulike te saporealizuara .Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme si banka, market, restorante, farmaci, linja transporti publik, shkolla etj, cka mundeson nje jetese shume komode. Apartamenti ka dokumetacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: At the former exhibition, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with perfect organization!!!
description_en: The apartment is located in the best area of ​​Tirana, just 5 minutes away from the center. Located on the 9th floor of a new building equipped with an elevator, with thermal insulation and high-quality work in the common areas. The apartment has a perfect floor plan with an area of ​​92 m2 net in the certificate. Its organization is as follows: a corridor which connects to the living room and the separate cooking corner, as well as to the balcony. The feature of this apartment in the daytime spaces is the glass window, which allows the apartment a natural light during most of the day. In the night spaces, the apartment has two matrimonial bedrooms, with a very spacious space and a quality investment. There are two toilets in the apartment which are easily accessible from all rooms. Currently, one of the toilets has been converted into a warehouse for the needs of the family. But it can easily return to its previous state. The apartment has been reconstructed and is easily distinguished by the newly realized electrical and plumbing installations. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities such as banks, markets, restaurants, pharmacies, public transport lines, schools, etc., which enables a very comfortable life. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
